title: FPIs net ₹53,739 crore into Indian equities over six trading sessions, 2–9 Nov 2026 (depository/NSDL data via PTI), after ₹35,861 crore (Sept) and ₹34,843 crore (Oct) of net selling; 2026 cumulative FPI equity outflow still ₹2.41 lakh crore; Geojit's V K Vijayakumar cites the AI-stock sell-off in the US, South Korea, Taiwan and Japan and better-than-expected Q2 results, with easing crude also cited; Sensex up more than 1,000 points in early trade on 11 Nov (first session after the 10 Nov holiday)
sources: Hindustan Times (11 Nov 2026, 09:16 IST): Sensex jumps over 1,200 points, Nifty crosses 25,350 as markets hit 8-month high
Business Standard (10 Nov 2026): Stock market holiday: NSE, BSE to remain closed for Diwali-Balipratipada; Hindustan Times (10 Nov 2026, 08:17 IST): Sensex, Nifty closed today for local holiday

Cumulative 2026 FPI equity outflow ₹2.41: Free Press Journal 10 Nov ('₹2.41 lakh crore')
consistent with The Hindu/PTI 1 Nov: ₹2.95 lakh crore to end-October minus ₹53,739 crore
